pages.text: Holds 4 spent rods and blocks $(bold)99%$() of their radiation.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: Put it in the controller's output slot to catch spent rods. Loaded, it gives Slowness I while carried.$(br2)$(danger)Spent rods are strong sources.$() Never carry them loose.

pages.title: Debris
pages.text: A cask with room can also pick up Reactor Debris. Mining debris by hand puts the source in your inventory.
